prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 30 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1425; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection, reporting neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with cervical whiplash injury. The mechanism of injury described is entirely plausible for a crash of this type. Over the course of 30 visits, care proceeded along a typical rehabilitation pathway, combining manual therapy, targeted stretching, and graded strengthening exercises. Range of motion gradually improved and pain levels decreased, and visit frequency was tapered accordingly as the patient progressed toward functional recovery. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm the presence of soft tissue injury to the cervical spine. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment to the neck or upper back, and no earlier complaints in this body area are documented in the available records. Billing for services reflects single, non-duplicated charges for each planned treatment, with no repeated billing for the same services. Ongoing monitoring is recommended, with discharge to home exercise as symptoms allow.
